items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: That was the era of time around when Benny Goodman and Mesereau and Dave Tuff and those musicians were in Chicago.

ctx.x: Well, you know, it slips your memory. You know, you soon forget about names and you meet so many musicians. But, you know, just like if you'd be out and you'd know where there's a band playing, you'd go anywhere, you'd be introduced, you'd sit out. And then maybe you wouldn't see them for quite a while after, or the slip of, you know, the remembrance of them.

That was the era of time around when Benny Goodman and Mesereau and Dave Tuff and those musicians were in Chicago. Yeah, at that time, yeah. Did you know Mesereau personally? No, I didn't know him personally, no. As you mentioned, record collectors were becoming in existence at that time.
Oh, yeah. Plenty of them, yeah.
